description: Ministry of Youth and Sports - Temporally Suspend the Registration of National Sport Association for Sri Lanka Rugby Association and Appoint Mr. A. Edirisuriya as Competent Authority
categorisation: This gazette names a specific individual (Namal Rajapaksha, Minister of Youth and Sports) and outlines detailed responsibilities and actions being taken (temporarily suspending registration of a sports association, appointing a competent authority, specifying administrative proceedings, calling for elections, and performing association activities). This combination of a named government official with specific portfolio responsibilities qualifies it as a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
